messages:
maria: Hey team — ACME Logistics (PO: PO-8793) says the credit note we issued (CN-2026-041) for a mid-cycle downgrade didn’t include VAT and doesn’t reference their PO. They were charged full for Mar (INV-2026-00312, $800.00 USD) but downgraded to Standard ($500.00) effective 2026-03-10. They’re asking for the partial refund or a credit note with PO on it. Can billing confirm the proration and reissue with VAT and PO?

julie: Customer attached PO PDF and wants vendor reference on the credit note ("ACME Logistics - PO-8793"). Payment method: card on file (****4242), charged 2026-03-01. They asked if refund can go back to card.

sam: I’ll validate invoice/ledger and run the proration calc. Quick numbers: billing cycle 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-31 (31 days). Pro plan $800/mo -> downgraded to $500 on 2026-03-10 (inclusive). Days on Pro: Mar 1-9 = 9 days. Days on Standard: Mar 10-31 = 22 days.

sam: Calculation (gross, pre-VAT):
```
period_days = 31
diff = 800 - 500 = 300
credit_days = 22
credit_amount = diff * credit_days / period_days = 300 * 22 / 31 = 212.9032258 -> round to 212.90
```

sam: VAT (20%) on the credit: 212.90 * 0.20 = 42.58 -> total refund = 212.90 + 42.58 = 255.48 USD. Rounding to 2 decimals.

invoices-bot: Invoice INV-2026-00312 · amount: $800.00 USD · tax: $133.33 (included) · payment: card ****4242 on 2026-03-01 · ledger id: L-99821 · original customer PO: none recorded.

sam: Notes: 1) original invoice had VAT included in the line items but we didn’t attach PO to CN. 2) We should issue CN that references INV-2026-00312 and includes the PO-8793 string in the credit note description/metadata for ACME accounting. 3) Payment processor supports partial refunds to card if transaction <= 180 days. This charge is within window (txn 2026-03-01).

sam: Proposed CN lines (gross):
- credit line: Service price difference 22 days = 212.90
- tax line: VAT 20% = 42.58
- total CN amount: 255.48
Please confirm ledger accounts to post and whether finance wants to refund to card or issue account credit.

alex: Approve reissue with PO on CN. Refund to card preferred. Make sure: CN references original invoice, include PO in both CN PDF and description field in our system. Update ledger with: Debit Revenue (300 * 22/31 minus tax), Debit VAT liability 42.58, Credit Accounts Payable (or cash/processor adjustment) 255.48. Add a note: "mid-cycle downgrade credit — pro-rated".

payments-ops: Confirmed — refund to card OK, processor limits satisfied. I need the original txn id (from invoices-bot/ledger) to trigger partial refund. If for any reason the card refund fails (chargeback/expired card), ops will convert CN into account credit and notify customer. Also: processor returns 2xx response + refund id; please copy that into the CN record.

sam: I pulled txn id: TXN-7a9f3c. I’ll create CN-2026-045 today, include PO-8793 in header and metadata, set tax lines per existing invoice, and schedule refund for EOD. I’ll attach CN PDF here when done.

maria: Thanks — please also update the customer-facing description to "Credit for mid-cycle downgrade (pro-rated) — references PO-8793" and cc support when CN issued so they can confirm with ACME.

sam: Will do. Marking as in-progress. :white_check_mark:

julie: Customer prefers refund to card — I’ll message them once CN + refund confirmed.

alex: One more compliance note — include VAT registration number on the CN PDF for EU VAT reclaim.

sam: Got it, I’ll include VAT reg no and attach PO. Will paste CN and refund confirmation when complete.
